thread:
maya: Heads-up — PR 14922 is ready for reviews, asking runtime/infra/security for quick eyes. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/14922
samir: pinging @julian (runtime) and @elena (infra) — can you take a look at the KV cache eviction changes?
julian: looking now, quick skim — main change is eviction threshold tweak + fallback path.
elena: I'll check infra side (allocation changes) — worried about bursty workloads.
maya: main ask: can we get approvals for canary tomorrow 10:00PT? want to start with 5% traffic.
samir: note: added canary config in repo; snippet:
```yaml
canary:
  start_time: "2024-06-18T10:00:00-07:00"
  percent: 5
  rollback_on_error: true
```
julian: I have one blocking comment about a race in kv_cache.cc — will push a small fix in a minute.
security-team: FYI I ran quick threat model — looks fine; need a KMS audit entry before prod. tagging @ops-bot for checklist.
ops-bot: checklist created: https://internal.redwood/checklists/pr-14922. Added KMS audit note.
elena: infra approval pending until load test results. can someone attach perf numbers from staging?
maya: staging perf attached: 99th-latency: 210ms, p50: 28ms, CPU/GPU util looks normal. link: https://perf.redwood/staging/14922
samir: if julian pushes the fix and tests pass can we merge after that and schedule canary? @platform-lead any objections to 10am?
platform-lead: SGTM. make sure release notes include fallback behavior and rollback steps. Also add canary monitor to Console (route /canary/14922).
julian: pushed fix, CI green.
maya: thanks — assigning approvals: @julian (runtime), @elena (infra), @security-team. Please add "approved" reactions when done.
elena: approved
julian: approved
security-team: approved (added KMS audit ticket ID: KMS-983)
maya: merging in 5m, will monitor 5-15m then ramp.
samir: thx all :thumbsup:
runtime-oncall-bot: Deploy started at 2024-06-18T10:00:05Z for canary 5%.
ops-bot: Canary monitors: latency, error-rate, model-outputs-drift. Alert if error-rate > 0.5% for 5m.
maya: all good so far. no alerts at +10m.
platform-lead: start ramp to 20% in 30m if stable.
maya: noted — scheduling ramp.
